decisions.decision: Rebuilt the plan's scratch verify-venv (/tmp/agentk-p2) on /opt/homebrew/bin/python3.12 instead of system python3 (3.9.6)
decisions.rationale: fastapi==0.139.2 requires Python >=3.10; pip silently excludes incompatible versions from its candidate list, which looked like 'the pin doesn't exist' but was actually a Python version mismatch in the throwaway venv, not a bad pin. All of CLAUDE.md's pinned versions were confirmed to exist on real PyPI.

decisions.decision: Fixed app/db.py's pgvector async registration to import from pgvector.asyncpg (register_vector) instead of pgvector.psycopg (register_vector_async)
decisions.rationale: Project uses the asyncpg driver (postgresql+asyncpg:// URL), not psycopg. pgvector.psycopg requires the unused psycopg package to even import, and doesn't export register_vector_async regardless. pgvector.asyncpg.register_vector is the correct API for this stack, confirmed by inspecting the installed package's real exports.
